checks.rule: Do not use a submitted clinical target or its direct aggregation to predict the same target.
Functional labels are targets and must be excluded from feature matrices.
Overlapping biological variants require grouped splits or explicit source-aware evaluation.
AlphaMissense is not converted to LOF/GOF or clinical ground truth.
Conversation memory is retrieval context only and cannot enter training labels or features.
Missing evidence means unavailable, not negative or benign.

training_policy: Only source-labelled, provenance-complete, experiment-specific targets may enter supervised training.
